kind.title: Kind
kind.autoHint: agnts picks the kind while reading the ticket
kind.codeHint: Implement a change. Needs a repository; ends in a pull request.
kind.testHint: Write or fix automated tests. Needs a repository; ends in a pull request.
kind.planHint: Write an implementation plan. Changes no code; ends in a report.
kind.analysisHint: Research a question and report the findings. Changes no code.
kind.bugHint: Find the root cause of a bug and propose a fix. Changes no code.
kind.pickerHint: What agnts produces. Choosing a kind makes it final; Auto lets agnts decide while reading the ticket.
kind.reviewHint: Review a pull request someone else opened. Comes from GitHub or GitLab.
kind.swaggertestHint: Test an HTTP API against its Swagger/OpenAPI spec. Repository optional; ends in a results table and a report.
